hook: Your drawing of Nepal's flag can't be a rectangle.
title: Your Nepal Flag Drawing Can't Be a Rectangle
description:
Nepal has the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle or square. It is made of two stacked triangles. The two points are said to stand for the Himalayas. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Nepal #FlagFacts
